query.example: how the parallelism cap is decided

sessionId.description: The session the agent is running in. Absent means the caller had no session — the telemetry row is still written (RN-479), only the `rag.search` timeline narration is skipped. Never invented by the api: a session it did not receive is a session that did not exist.

agent.description: Agent slug, recorded as the telemetry actor (`actor_kind: agent`). Absent falls back to the `system` actor rather than inventing a user.
